resources.string: In the PayPay app, open 取引履歴 (transaction history), tap the download button, pick a period of up to a year, and save the CSV file. Payments already recorded from their emails are skipped, and importing an overlapping period adds each payment once.
In 三菱UFJダイレクト, open 入出金明細, pick the period, and download the CSV file. Rows already imported, or already recorded from notifications, are skipped.

In BudgetBakers’ Wallet app, export your records as CSV (on the web app: Records → Export), then choose the file here. You can choose where its accounts and categories go before anything is imported. Importing the same file twice adds nothing new.

Hold a Suica, PASMO, ICOCA or other transit IC card to the back of the phone to import its train and bus fares, shop payments and top-ups. The card keeps only its last 20 entries, so read it every week or two. Mobile Suica on this phone can’t be read this way.
There are no payments in this file.
There are no records in this file.
Choose a category for each shop. A shop’s category is remembered, so its next payments are sorted too.
Choose a category for each payee, such as your employer for salary. It is remembered for the next statement; payees left without one are imported without a category, to sort later.
And where each category’s records go. Close matches are picked; BudgetBakers’ categories that fit none of yours can be added as they are.
Choose a category for each kind of entry. It is remembered for the next time you read a card.
